title: The Sunday
description:
The SundayThe Sunday is a short walkthrough horror game where the idea of being alone will hunt you, until the drakness settles in your brain. The line between reality and nightmare is razor thin.
You wake up hangover after a party, alone. Your parents took a short trip to visit one of your relatives that is sick. It only takes a little time until the voices start to become a part of the reality.

The GameplayThe Sunday is a first-person walkthrough horror simulator, so the main mechanic is explorationFeatures- Horror ambience
- Relistic graphics
- Ambient light
- Dialogues with NPCs
